reviews.comment: Alan is an aggressive and at time disrespectful lecturer and has the most disrespectul TAs ive ever seen. There are large discrepencies in the way that the TAs grade and provide resources to the different groups in the class. He is big on coming and presenting up front and will be agressive with his feedback (not always in the most productive way)
I really enjoyed this class and Dr. Grant as a person. He is super great as a lecturer and just an all around interesting person.  You will learn a lot and you'll be inspired!  Just take him :)

Professor Grant is hands down the best professor I have at A&M. He is an awesome guy and goes out of his way to make this class really fun. Though this is listed as a "sports comm" course, I learned a ton about other valuable areas of life. Go to lectures and guest speakers and you will take a lot of from this class. Couldn't recommend enough.

Professor Grant is amazing! If you have any interest towards sports and enjoy talking about your own personal experiences and views then this class is for you. Assignments were easy and enough time is given for them to be completed. Hes very interactive and wants you to participate. No exams, all assignments are writing assignment. Great class!

Professor Grant was very knowledgeable about each topic, but was not very structured in his grading policies or assignment structure. He promised bonus points for wearing a mask but never distributed these points. Did not give clear structure for the group project, then graded strictly. Attendance was mandatory. If you do the work you will pass.

Prof. Grant is awesome. His lectures are not only very entertaining and informative, but he gives out an awesome vibe that makes the students want to engage in the conversation. Like any other COMM class there is a lot of reading and essays required, but he is not a tough grader at all. This the best class any sport-loving person can take.

Alan is an AMAZING PROF!! He's lectures are more of a group conversation, and it is about things that are actually relevant and interesting. He is a very easy grader and given insightful feedback. He said multiple times this class is supposed to be fun and not stressful. Show up to class bc attendance is a MAJOR portion of your grade!!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Mr. Grant is a cool dude. I enjoyed his class, however, he was often unprepared and would basically let the class have their own discussion. While this was nice some of the time, there should have been a bit more structure. He would occasionally change deadlines or assignment requirements on a whim but is very forgiving and understanding.

This professor cares so much about his students and wants you to succeed! His lectures are interesting and every class is interactive and includes discussion. There arent any multiple choice exams, it is more writing based and as long as you follow the rubric and come to class you will succeed! Definitely requires effort but its worth it :)
